svg.aria-label: Hard SPN / LowMC-style linear-form and nonlinear S-box circuit architecture

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Hard SPN / LowMC-Style Linear-Form + Nonlinear Circuits (hard-spn)
Affine 𝔽₂ diffusion layer (r = n/2 sparse 5-XOR rows) coupled with 3-bit S-box gates (And, Maj₃, Mux) evaluated on 3-input linear forms ℓ = xᵢ ⊕ xⱼ ⊕ xₖ
Circuit Topology (src/main.rs — LowMC / SPN Algebraic Round Coupling)
1. Affine 𝔽₂ Linear Diffusion Layer: L · x = b (mod 2)
Row j: xᵢ₁ ⊕ xᵢ₂ ⊕ xᵢ₃ ⊕ xᵢ₄ ⊕ xᵢ₅ = bⱼ
Planted secret x★ sets b = L·x★ (mod 2).
Why Linear Forms Defeat Flat CDCL
S-boxes read ℓ = xᵢ ⊕ xⱼ ⊕ xₖ,
not raw bits xᵢ — blocking BCP.
*n48_d24 flips last S-box target bit v₃₇ → UNSAT
